purpose: ADR-0085 P4 isolated read-only MCP surface for the bounded research-judgment composition; non-exposure, not permission denial

dedicated_isolation.note: In read-only mode the server reads ONLY the dedicated port/token and refuses to start without a valid TCP port and token, so it can never silently share the Product endpoint or credential.

implementation: services/mcp/src/server.ts buildServer uses an explicit, type-checked guarded registration function (no registerTool overwrite); in read-only mode only the five bounded read tools are registered and every other registration is a no-op. The default surface is unchanged.
test_method: spawns two real servers on separate ephemeral ports with separate credentials and calls the REAL MCP tools/list through @modelcontextprotocol/client; a failed start or an unanswered tools/list fails the test, so a trailing exit 0 cannot mask a broken surface
negative_control: patching the built server to ignore BYQ_MCP_READ_ONLY_SUBSET makes the same test exit 1 (subset == full surface), proving the assertion is fail-able
remaining_unproven: root and child actual tool arrays captured from the real DSH carrier with this read-only MCP loaded
the five read tools' bounded return sizes and sensitive-field behaviour
the child persona actually invoked and its closed result parsed
real Product API -> Runtime Adapter -> DSH -> Backend closed loop
